text.tspan: ​median of per-call throughputs, 95% interval on the median shaded; L-BFGS-B to a projected gradient of 1e-09, jit warmed up​
​the host's per-call dispatch latency, measured separately, is subtracted off every point​
​only the hpc parts run f64 at full rate; the rest are 1/32 or 1/64 in hardware​
